source_visual_observations: Triangle CED below horizontal AB, with E on AB; AEC=35° and CED=90°; CD is parallel to AB.
audit.independent_solution: AB is parallel to CD, so ECD=35°. In triangle CED, E=90°, hence D=180−90−35=55°, choice B.
